title: Codex is now generally available
summary: OpenAI Codex is now generally available with powerful new features for developers: a Slack integration, Codex SDK, and admin tools like usage dashboards and workspace management—making Codex easier to use and manage at scale.
body: OpenAI Codex is now generally available with powerful new features for developers: a Slack integration, Codex SDK, and admin tools like usage dashboards and workspace management—making Codex easier to use and manage at scale.
summaryZh: OpenAI Codex宣布正式全面可用（GA），并为广大开发者带来了多项强大且实用的新特性。其中包括Slack深度集成、Codex软件开发工具包（SDK），以及面向管理员的使用仪表盘和工作空间管理工具，使得Codex在企业和大规模团队中更加易于使用和管理。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI Codex正式全面可用，并引入了Slack集成与SDK等重磅开发者功能，对大模型代码生态影响深远。
